name: doubted-wrong-total

finding.title: `discountFor` returns a percentage where its caller expects a fraction
finding.description: The PR multiplies the tier rate by 100. `invoiceTotal` in `internal/billing/invoice.go` computes `net * (1 - discountFor(c))`, so a customer on a 15 percent tier is charged `net * -14` and every discounted invoice gets a negative total.
